body: Should we support calling `.toJSON()` on objects since `JSON.stringify()` [handles this](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/JSON/stringify)? e.g. `JSON.stringify({ a: new Date() })` returns `'{"a":"2020-03-09T17:17:44.849Z"}'`
